subject: Plinki
fact: Plinki's mind was a screeching, red mess of 'Sacrifice! Power! For the Big Baboon Demon!'
source_quote: Plinki, her mind was just a screeching, red mess of 'Sacrifice! Power! For the Big Baboon Demon!'

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum was trying to talk to Plinki, something about choice and dragon gods. His thoughts were so... earnest and golden-yellow!

subject: Eldeth
fact: Eldeth, her thoughts just went *AAAAH-PAIN!* and it was like gEttin g stabbed with a rusty-tasting needle!

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir, the quiet, scaly one, his mind is usually like a still, cool pond, you know? But he just decided—no more light! *FWOOMP.* And the whole world went psychically gray and muffled!
source_quote: Zalthir—oh, Zalthir, the quiet, scaly one, his mind is usually like a still, cool pond, you know? But he just decided—no more light! *FWOOMP.* And the whole world went psychically gray and muffled!

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin, he just charged right into that black cloud. His mind was a simple, bright axe-blade of 'HIT THE BAD THING.'
source_quote: The Dwarf, Thorin, he just charged right into that black cloud. His mind was a simple, bright axe-blade of 'HIT THE BAD THING.'

subject: Daz
fact: Daz, the clever Drow, his thoughts are like a spiderweb, all intricate and patient. He said, 'Maximilian's Earthen Grasp,' and the ground just reached up with a big muddy thought and *SQUEEZED* the eye-thing!
source_quote: Daz, the clever Drow, his thoughts are like a spiderweb, all intricate and patient. He said, 'Maximilian's Earthen Grasp,' and the ground just reached up with a big muddy thought and *SQUEEZED* the eye-thing!

subject: Zalthir
fact: I heard him think, 'The leader is the lynchpin. Neutralize Plinki.' And then he opened his mouth and the thought turned into ROARING-HOT-AGONY-FIRE! Plinki's mind just... went out. Like a candle flame.
source_quote: I heard him think, 'The leader is the lynchpin. Neutralize Plinki.' And then he opened his mouth and the thought turned into ROARING-HOT-AGONY-FIRE! Plinki's mind just... went out. Like a candle flame.

subject: Zalthir
fact: I heard him think, 'This one is the most dangerous. Their skill is a threat.' and he just... grabbed the thief-derro! The thief's surprise was a sharp, lemon-zest tang of 'What-?!' and then Zalthir, so silent, so focused, *threw him off the ledge!*

subject: Thief-Derro
fact: The feeling of falling, the brief moment of weightlessness, was followed by a CRUNCH of pain that tasted like biting on stone!
source_quote: The feeling of falling, the brief moment of weightlessness, was followed by a CRUNCH of pain that tasted like biting on stone!

subject: Zalthir
fact: Then Zalthir was on him, and it was just... *thud, thud, thud.* No anger, no rage, just... methodical dismantling.
source_quote: Then Zalthir was on him, and it was just... *thud, thud, thud.* No anger, no rage, just... methodical dismantling.

subject: Pelek
fact: Pelek, he tried to get in the thief's head! It was like trying to pour hot tea and cold water into the same cup, all sizzle and steam and wrongness!
source_quote: And the poor ghost, Pelek, he tried to get in the thief's head! It was like trying to pour hot tea and cold water into the same cup, all sizzle and steam and wrongness!

subject: Daz
fact: The wizard, Daz, his mind went all silvery and he just... wasn't there anymore! A little psychic *poof* and then he was by the egg, and the anxiety coming off him was a physical wave! 'Get it, get it, get it, get out!' his thoughts screamed.
source_quote: The wizard, Daz, his mind went all silvery and he just... wasn't there anymore! A little psychic *poof* and then he was by the egg, and the anxiety coming off him was a physical wave! 'Get it, get it, get it, get out!' his thoughts screamed.

subject: Derro
fact: All the other derro felt it at once! Their minds exploded in a chorus of 'WHERE IS THE EGG?! THE EGG! WHO HAS THE EGG?!' It was a psychic tsunami of panic!
source_quote: And all the other derro felt it at once! Their minds exploded in a chorus of 'WHERE IS THE EGG?! THE EGG! WHO HAS THE EGG?!' It was a psychic tsunami of panic!

subject: Zalthir
